spec_match.rationale: Creates the exact scenario the explainer targets — a long task blocking a worker's event loop — with a real 300ms in-worker spin, a real in-worker LoAF observer (with the type-supported distinction), and the queued-message latency the entry would attribute.

interactive.rationale: Live 100ms ping loop, block button injecting real jank, spiking round-trip meter, LoAF entry counter, and a timestamped log.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises two instruments — universal latency spike plus Chrome-153 entries; both implemented.

edge_cases.rationale: Observer state distinguishes active / attached-but-type-unsupported (the silent-skip trap, fixed after live verification) / rejected; the meter works regardless.

conformance.rationale: The suite's blocked-worker-produces-entry assertion runs this page's exact mechanism self-contained.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP runs: real 128–228ms round-trip spikes measured during the 300ms block, LoAF count honestly 0 with the silent-skip explanation after the fix; re-verified from fresh reload; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts on boot state, block requests, and any real entries with their durations.

design_system.rationale: Spiking meter flips to accent-rose; CSS variables only; instruments on paper (AA).

accessibility.rationale: LoAF counter and log are aria-live; the fast-updating round-trip meter is deliberately aria-live off with spikes narrated into the log instead; native button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Instrument duo collapses under 700px; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: See entries count up on Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: On a supporting engine each block should add an entry with duration ≈300ms and blocking ≈250ms alongside the latency spike.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep rapidly-updating numerics out of live regions; narrate meaningful transitions instead.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The 10Hz round-trip meter is aria-live=off; spikes over 120ms are logged into the aria-live log.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep monitoring cadence coarse enough not to be the load itself.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: 100ms ping cadence; the block is the only heavy work.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the block genuinely stalls the worker (measured 128–228ms ping spikes) while the entry counter stays honestly at zero on Chromium 141 with the silent-skip state explained. Fresh-reload re-verification after the copy fix.
